fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld) are a near-verbatim spread of the page's NewsArticle JSON-LD block, so extra schema.org fields beyond those listed here may appear. Latest-mode records (S2-rss) carry title/link-style fields from the site-wide RSS feed.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-jsonld or S2-rss).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed extractions -- the error kind.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline (raw passthrough from JSON-LD NewsArticle).

alternativeHeadline.title: Alternative headline
alternativeHeadline.description: Secondary/SEO headline variant, when present in JSON-LD.

description.title: Description
description.description: Short article description/dek (article-mode from JSON-LD, or the RSS item description in latest-mode).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text, present on every sampled article's JSON-LD NewsArticle node.

author.title: Author
author.description: Author object(s) as emitted by upstream JSON-LD (raw passthrough -- array of Person/Organization, e.g. a named byline or a wire-service credit like PTI/AFP).

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Comma-separated keyword/tag string, as emitted upstream.

about.title: About
about.description: Array of Thing entities (topics) the article is about, as emitted upstream.

genre.title: Genre
genre.description: Upstream genre tag, typically mirrors the section name.

url.title: Canonical URL
url.description: Canonical article URL as emitted in JSON-LD.

creator.title: Creator
creator.description: RSS dc:creator byline, e.g. 'AFP', 'PTI', or a named reporter (latest-mode).

contentEncoded.title: Content (encoded)
contentEncoded.description: Full article HTML (image figure + paragraphs) from the RSS item's content:encoded element (latest-mode).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
